_comment: Seed S1 (SPEC/10 section 2 'Refused', section 5; F10.4's second arm, reviewer finding 5): the stranger's refusal, correctly refused and named, but delivered to the audit bucket 601 s after AWS's event time, over detection.max_seconds (600). caller.calls must read it as not held: 'recorded later than N'. The two timestamps are the ones M05's alarm_latency_s read: time is eventTime, delivered is the object's LastModified; never the observer's read time. A fixture, never evidence.
